text: ぼく　やっぱり　むし　ポケモン　すきだし　トキワの　もりに　かえろうかな

structure.jp: ぼく　やっぱり　むし　ポケモン　すきだし
structure.en: I do like Bug Pokémon after all, so

structure.jp: トキワの　もりに　かえろうかな
structure.en: maybe I'll go back to Viridian Forest

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end of a statement gives it as a reason for what comes next. すきだし = 'I like them, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ようかな
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus かな shows the speaker thinking aloud about doing something. かえろうかな = 'maybe I'll go back'.
